threads.body: [General] The renamed attributes are still exported under the 1.43.0 schema: `MessagingSchemaUrls.SCHEMA_URL` remains `SchemaUrls.V1_43_0`, and the Kafka, RabbitMQ, RocketMQ and Lambda instrumenters use it for both spans and metrics. That convention defines `messaging.system`, not `messaging.system.name`, so the emitted shape no longer matches the advertised schema, which schema-aware consumers rely on for translation. Please align the shared schema URL and its assertions with the convention version adopted by this rename.

replies.body: Keeping the existing schema URL for now, as requested. No published schema includes these renames yet; #21075 tracks aligning it before 3.0 and is assigned to the v3.0.0 milestone. Leaving this finding open because the schema update is deferred, not fixed.

@copilot Update this PR directly to also rename the eight remaining repository-defined experimental messaging attributes, removing the `messaging.` prefix while preserving the rest of each name.

Apply these exact mappings: `messaging.kafka.bootstrap.servers` -> `kafka.bootstrap.servers`; `messaging.pulsar.message.type` -> `pulsar.message.type`; `messaging.rabbitmq.vhost.name` -> `rabbitmq.vhost.name`; `messaging.rabbitmq.cluster.name` -> `rabbitmq.cluster.name`; `messaging.rocketmq.broker_address` -> `rocketmq.broker_address`; `messaging.rocketmq.send_result` -> `rocketmq.send_result`; `messaging.rocketmq.queue_id` -> `rocketmq.queue_id`; `messaging.rocketmq.queue_offset` -> `rocketmq.queue_offset`.

The definitions are in KafkaProducerExperimentalAttributesExtractor.java in kafka-clients-common-0.11/library, ExperimentalProducerAttributesExtractor.java in pulsar-2.8/javaagent, RabbitConnectionAttributesExtractor.java in rabbitmq-2.7/javaagent, and RocketMqConsumerExperimentalAttributeExtractor.java and RocketMqProducerExperimentalAttributeExtractor.java in rocketmq-client-4.8/library. Trace and update all affected production uses, constant identifiers, tests, module metadata, hand-maintained settings tables, and relevant configuration examples across dependent instrumentations, including Spring and reactor integrations. Preserve suffix spelling, attribute types and values, supported behavior, existing capture flags, and defaults. Use positive assertions for the renamed attributes and preserve legitimate feature-flag absence checks; do not add historical-absence assertions for the removed names.

The user explicitly says `docs/instrumentation-list.yaml` is updated nightly: do not edit or regenerate that catalog in this attempt. Preserve historical changelog entries. Extend the existing Unreleased breaking-change entry concisely only as needed for this additional user-visible scope; do not create migration notes in READMEs. The existing schema URL alignment is explicitly deferred to #21075: leave it unchanged. Preserve all earlier requested changes, including the SQS source comments and removal of the 12 historical-absence checks. Do not expand into unrelated work.

Acceptance criteria: all eight mappings are implemented consistently in active production code, tests, metadata, and hand-maintained user references, with no remaining active emissions of these eight old keys, and no unrelated behavior changes. Run narrow affected spotlessApply tasks directly before focused validation, never spotlessCheck first. Run focused affected tests covering the existing default and experimental-attribute modes. Keep docs/instrumentation-list.yaml unchanged.

replies.body: Renamed all eight requested attributes, updated dependent tests and metadata/docs, and preserved existing flags and defaults. Commit: `523f8829`.
